items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Jim Humphrey was teaching, teaching me clarinet... I took lessons from him.

ctx.x: Oh, well. Yes. Can you tell us about the, your lessons you mentioned yesterday? You had some lessons with, uh, old professor Jim Humphrey.
Humphrey, yes. Did you take any other lessons before that? No, sir, I hadn't. Only with Jim Humphrey.
When you started on the violin, did you have lessons right away on that, or? No, I didn't have no lesson. I didn't play.
